propositions.text_en: Growth holds near 0.7%; inflation rises

propositions.text_en: The BOJ raised the target by a 7–2 majority as wage and input costs spread into prices. Further normalization depends on activity, inflation and financial conditions.
propositions.text_zh: 工资与投入成本向价格传导，日银以7票对2票上调目标。后续正常化取决于经济活动、通胀与金融条件。
propositions.derivation: Latest verified national decision; no predicted rate path or cross-instrument stance comparison.

policy_decision.instrument_zh: 无担保隔夜拆借利率目标

monthly_context.definition: From 24 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.25 percent; From 17 Jun 2026 to 23 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.00 percent; From 22 Dec 2025 to 16 Jun 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.75 percent; From 27 Jan 2025 to 21 Dec 2025: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.50 percent; From 1 Aug 2024 to 26 Jan 2025: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.25% ; From 21 Mar 2024 to 31 July: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1 %; from 21 Sep 2016 to 20 Mar 2024: the BOJ set the guideline for market operations which specifies a short-term policy interest rate at minus 0.1% and a target level of 10-year JGB yields at around 0%. Short-term policy interest rate; from 4 Apr 2013 to 20 Sep 2016: no policy rate; from 5 Oct 2010 to 3 Apr 2013: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1%; from 19 Dec 2008 to 4 Oct 2010: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0. %; from 31 Oct 2008 to 18 Dec 2008: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.3%; before 30 Oct 2008, refer to https://data.bis.org/topics/CBPOL

propositions.text_zh: 增长平稳，通胀预计升高
propositions.derivation: Same release and periods; next minus current annual rates. Changes within 0.15 pp are described as broadly steady.

propositions.text_en: The baseline retains an external surplus. Its composition matters more than the sign alone.
propositions.text_zh: 基准预测维持经常账户盈余，其构成比正负号本身更重要。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: The projected deficit widens as a share of GDP.
propositions.text_zh: 预测赤字占GDP比率扩大。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: Debt falls relative to GDP in the baseline.
propositions.text_zh: 基准预测中债务占GDP比率下降。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: Growth holds near 0.7%; inflation rises
propositions.text_zh: 增长维持约0.7%，通胀上升
propositions.derivation: Country reading of selected published annual paths; exact rules and dependencies retained.

propositions.text_en: The BOJ raised the target by a 7–2 majority as wage and input costs spread into prices. Further normalization depends on activity, inflation and financial conditions.
propositions.text_zh: 工资与投入成本向价格传导，日银以7票对2票上调目标。后续正常化取决于经济活动、通胀与金融条件。
propositions.derivation: Latest verified national decision; no predicted rate path or cross-instrument stance comparison.

propositions.text_en: Wage inflation keeps normalization in play
propositions.text_zh: 工资通胀推动政策正常化
propositions.derivation: Reviewed country mechanism; requalified from current evidence on every build.

policy_decision.rationale_en: The BOJ raised the target by a 7–2 majority as wage and input costs spread into prices. Further normalization depends on activity, inflation and financial conditions.
policy_decision.rationale_zh: 工资与投入成本向价格传导，日银以7票对2票上调目标。后续正常化取决于经济活动、通胀与金融条件。
policy_decision.instrument_zh: 无担保隔夜拆借利率目标
